beats.speaker: me
beats.text: My resume is perfect. Read it.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Not 'grew sales.' Say 'grew sales forty percent in six months.'

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Tip two: tailor it to every job.
beats.title: 2. Tailor every time

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Use their words. Show you read the job post.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: One resume for every job. That's a lot of resumes.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Tip three: make it easy to skim.
beats.title: 3. Easy to skim

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Recruiters skim in seconds. Short bullets, results first.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Wait. I just got an interview!

messages.text: Are you free for an interview on Monday?

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Save this before you apply anywhere.
